content.rendered:
?
Psalms 30:12 MSG I’m about to burst with song; I can’t keep quiet about you. God, my God, I can’t thank you enough.
☝that exclamation connote only one thing…something great & unusual was about to happen to the psalmist..
?He must have seen, experienced or perhaps known something.
?His expectations were about to manifest.?God’s got things going again for him.?God was about to take away his shame & reproach.?His antagonists were about to be silenced for good.
?This will be your story today.✔This too will be your testimony.
?And for the rest of the year, your testimonies will be so amazing you won’t be able to keep them to yourself…There will be no advertisements as they will advertize themselves in Jesus name.
See?Amos 9v13-15. MSG “Yes indeed, it won’t be long now.” God’s Decree.”Things are going to happen so fast your head will swim, one thing fast on the heels of the other. You won’t be able to keep up. Everything will be happening at once—and everywhere you look, blessings! Blessings like wine pouring off the mountains and hills. I’ll make everything right again for my people Israel:
?congratulations in Jesus name????????
Please be informed that WORD4TODAY will go on recess on Friday, 20th December to resume stronger in the NewYear in Jesus name.
